description: Apply a setup from its text or a URL, merging or replacing; 422 with the errors and nothing applied when it is invalid.

confirm_removed_count.description:
For `replace` imports: how many items the validation said would be removed; the
import is refused when it differs.

format.description: `toml`, `json` or `yaml`, when the URL or the text does not say.

headers.description: Headers for a private URL, each as `Name: value`; never shown or logged.

passphrase.description:
Opens the file's encrypted secrets. The CLI reads `SENDMOCK_SETUP_PASSPHRASE` when the
flag is not given.

setup_text.description: The setup file's text, in TOML, JSON or YAML; or give `url`.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 the download must have, as 64 hexadecimal digits.

url.description:
Download the setup from this `https://` URL (plain `http://` only for loopback and
private addresses): at most 1 MB, 10 seconds and 3 redirects, all to `https://`.

name: sendmock_setup_import
